user.title: NSPanel Lovelace UI
user.description:
Panels and cards are configured in a YAML file in the Home Assistant configuration folder (same format as the add-on's panels.yaml). To migrate, enter your AppDaemon apps.yaml (or an add-on panels.yaml) as the import file; it is converted into the configuration file, which must not exist yet.

{error}

data_description.config_file: Path relative to the configuration folder, e.g. nspanel_lovelace_ui/panels.yaml.
data_description.import_file: Path relative to the configuration folder, e.g. appdaemon/apps/apps.yaml.
